blends.name: Eternal Blaze
blends.desc:
Congratulations!

If you are here, it means you have gone further than most ever will. Through patience, precision, and unwavering dedication, you have obtained both Fox Ember and Azure Heart—two forces never meant to coexist.

It is now time to complete the final step of the Loyalty Quest. Bring these relics together and witness what few have ever seen. This is not a simple transformation… it is a convergence of forbidden fire and divine strength.

But be warned… such power was never meant to be wielded. Once the ritual begins, there is no turning back. What emerges from this union will surpass both relics—and may prove too great for any to control.

Proceed only if you believe you are worthy.

blends.name: Fox Ember
blends.desc:
Congratulations!

If you are here, it means your efforts have paid off. You’ve shown consistency on Twitch—and even achieved a perfect guess to earn a Lucky Willy. Not many can say the same.

It is now time to progress in the Loyalty Quest. Gather the Scroll Ashes you’ve collected and let Lucky Willy work his magic, transforming them into a powerful source of energy.

But be warned… this flame was never meant to rise again. Complete the ritual swiftly—and pray that no one witnesses what you are about to awaken.

blends.name: Perfect Day with Luna
blends.desc:
Congratulations! 

If you are here, it means you've successfully followed Toby’s directions and discovered the hidden Trading Post, a noteworthy achievement in itself.

Consider yourself fortunate, Axel is in a good mood today and open to trading with you. However, his deals don't come cheap. He's offering to trade 5 of your NFTs for only 1 of his. Are you up for the challenge?

Be cautious not to part with NFTs you can't afford to lose. Once the deal is sealed, there's no turning back. You won't have a second chance to reclaim them.  Take a moment to contemplate your decision. It's never too late to exit the woods without engaging in business with this enigmatic squirrel.

**Requirements** : You need to own a copy of Axel's Trading Post to be eligible for this blend.
